title: Testing Your Plugin
desc: Keeping tests and fixtures inside the plugin folder.
lede: Tests travel with the plugin, so an engine repo proves itself wherever it lives.
body:
At a glance
  • Plugin-local tests/ are collected by pytest.
  • A contract test checks the required surface.
  • Fixtures and generated outputs live with the plugin.

Plugin-local tests

Keep tests inside the plugin folder. They're collected alongside the app's tests, so the engine is verified in place.

The contract test

A contract test confirms the engine implements the required methods with the expected behavior — the fastest way to catch a broken plugin.

Fixtures

Ship fixtures (and any generated outputs) with the plugin so tests are deterministic and self-contained.
